description: A platform enables Musicians generate Audio-Visual NFT artworks and PFPs(not developed yet)) easily, with AI generating perfectly matched image/video. how_its_made: This project is totally based on Lens Protocol and should all use polygon main net (not developed yet) finish minting and auctioning. For music encrypting art part, we use ALDA a music programming language to support. For AI art part, we use Disco Diffusion, StyleGAN and MidJourney.
